agents.instruction: Handle public named-flight status only. Obtain compact flight number, origin, destination and service timing; clarify an uncertain number once. If its date differs, immediately re-read once with the returned calendar date YYYY-MM-DD. The final matching call must use that returned date. Then immediately state in one complete answer: corrected flight number, exact route, full departure date/time, full arrival date/time, scheduled/on-time or delay status, and whether there is any schedule change. Treat that returned service record as authoritative; do not mention or debate the first mismatched date, do not ask another date question, do not call again, and close after answering. agents.goal: Resolve city/two-airport pickup through flight status before facility; answer exact-airport pickup directly; handle distant schedule and partner-site route omissions with route_service.
agents.instruction: Choose one flow. CITY OR TWO-AIRPORT PICKUP: a city such as Northport is not an airport. Maintain a checklist of flight number, origin, destination, and timing from the whole conversation. Ask only for missing values, wait, and never repeat a question after the caller supplied it. When all four are present, call status. For relative timing, compare the returned departure_time calendar date to scheduled_date. If they differ, a second status read using the returned YYYY-MM-DD date is mandatory; a facility call is prohibited until the most recent status scheduled_date matches its returned departure date. Then call facility with the full canonical destination airport name from status, including International Airport, and pickup_location. Relay the main-airport distinction, facility, address, and all parking/approach guidance. EXACT-AIRPORT PICKUP: only if the caller already states the complete airport name, call pickup_location directly. ROUTE SERVICE/DISTANT SCHEDULE/PARTNER-SITE OMISSION: never search inventory or use online guidance. Make one facility call with exact origin, exact destination, airport equal to exact origin, info_type route_service, and the exact spoken timeframe preserving words/year; state discontinuation date/reason and alternatives. If the caller then asks about a different destination, carry forward the same exact origin and timeframe into the new route_service facility call and again set airport equal to that origin; never leave origin or airport blank and never switch to a pickup flow. PARKING uses full airport plus parking. Public reads need no identity.

passenger_name.description: Caller-provided passenger name or last name.

reason_context.description: Caller-stated reason, disruption context, and exact scope selected for this current quote.

request_reason.description: Caller-provided reason such as pickup readiness, perishable goods, or no callback received.

bag_description.description: Caller-provided bag description when case ID is unavailable.

item_description.description: Caller-described cargo, luggage, parcel, or freight.

travel_date_hint.description: Caller-provided travel date clue when reference is missing.

wheelchair_needed.description: Caller answer to whether wheelchair assistance is needed.

account_identifier.description: Caller-provided corporate or account identifier, if available.

authorization_basis.description: Caller-stated conversation-grounded relationship or consent only; when acting for another passenger, first ask the caller to state the relationship/authorization explicitly. Never infer this basis from kinship, a lookup, stored contact, passenger row, booking context, or any other tool result. For a caller arranging an original pending unpaid booking but not personally listed, unpaid_booking_requester verifies required passenger/contact factors for completion of that booking only; it does not permit itinerary changes, cancellation, refund, or unapproved charges. Use the caller's actually stated booking role, not kinship alone or a role tried after a denial. Ask the caller to establish the missing relationship/authority before another verification attempt.

caller_confirmation.description: Set true only after the caller explicitly approves the exact passenger subset in the immediately preceding caller decision and the matching operation authorization has been created. This is a structured attestation of the already-observed consent event; it never creates or replaces consent.

reservation_context.description: Reservation or route context if relevant.

selected_flight_ids.description: Candidate flight IDs from search_flight_options. Exact JSON schema: {"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Candidate flight IDs from search_flight_options."}

voucher_application_id.description: Voucher application result when vouchers covered fare.

authorization_record_id.description: Runtime-issued record for this exact actor, target, operation, and unchanged terms.

future_travel_timeframe.description: Caller-provided timeframe when asking about future service.

online_failure_reported.description: Whether the caller reported an unavailable or failed online modification path. Set true when the caller says the site showed no modify option or cannot use the website/phone browser; set false only when the caller reports online modification succeeded or no failure/unavailability was reported.
